_comment: Pre-registered closing rules R1-R4 - FROZEN 2026-08-24 (orchestra bus message '平仓规则定稿 v1') BEFORE the contest window. Judges: parameters were fixed before any live run; changing them mid-contest would show in git history.
_execution_note: close_cross_frac is EXECUTION, not a rule: the R1-R4 thresholds above are unchanged from the 2026-08-24 freeze and decide WHETHER to close. This decides the price of the resulting order. Added 2026-08-26 after live-fire testing showed a close priced at snapshot mid does not fill (asked 4.00 credit, executable was 3.82) - merely slow for R2/R3/R4, but it defeats R1, whose entire purpose is to be OUT before assignment week. R1 also escalated to a market order for the same reason. No threshold was touched.
